title: Ratchet: enforce that every GitHub Actions `uses:` ref stays SHA-pinned
description: Follow-up to THE-157. Every `uses:` in `.github/workflows/*.yml` is currently a 40-hex SHA, but nothing enforces it: a future edit can reintroduce a mutable tag, and the local `./.github/actions/ci-setup` is unpinned. Add a ratchet/CI check (in `just lint`) that fails on any non-SHA external action ref, with an explicit, reasoned allowlist for local `./` actions.
